title: action renderers (action:button, action:icon, action:group, action:menu) draw a control disabled by its declared `disabled` predicate with no reason: no tooltip or accessible description
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, class (a), reach by a named real producer. `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts:413`–`:419` (objectstack `main`) declares `showcase_archive_task` the `disabled`-predicate specimen, and says it "exercises the renderer-side wiring (objectui: DeclaredActionsBar + action:button/group/icon/menu)". Reader: objectui triage first-touch (grade and route).
Dedupe (MCP `search_issues`, objectui, open + closed):
- "disabled action no reason tooltip action:button disabled predicate explanation aria-describedby" returned objectui#11811 (open), this family's first card. It fixes the record header (`page:header`), the section bar (`record:quick_actions`) and `DeclaredActionsBar`. The renderers below are not on its surface.
- objectui#11811 is the positive control.

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat 3 (`session_01CGZy1BGCjdN5cXqL9cnvB8`) from the objectui#11811 dev report (`6049038332`, out-of-scope finding 1). ⛔ Not graded or routed here; ⛔ not a claim.

## What happens

objectui#11811 gives a predicate-disabled action the generic reason "Not available for this record", through a focusable wrapper and an `sr-only` description, on three renderers. The `action:*` renderers in `packages/components/src/renderers/action/` (`action-button.tsx`, `action-icon`, `action-group.tsx`, `action-menu`) evaluate the same declared `disabled` predicate and draw a disabled control with no reason, per the objectui#11811 dev's reading of the source.

Two measured facts from that report apply here:
- objectui's `Button` primitive has `disabled:pointer-events-none`, so a `title` on a disabled button never shows. Measured in Chromium: `elementFromPoint` returns the parent, and the button gets no `pointerenter`.
- A focusable wrapper span receives hover and Tab focus.

Not measured in a browser on these renderers.

## Done when

- Each `action:*` renderer explains a predicate-disabled control the same way objectui#11811 does: a tooltip on hover and focus, and an accessible description, with the key objectui#11811 adds. A loading-disabled or host-disabled control is unchanged.
- The claimant decides whether the wrapper, which by then has three local copies (app-shell, plugin-detail, components' `containers.tsx`), becomes one shared helper. Exporting it from `@object-ui/components` widens the public surface (`Clause-②`), so name the choice.
- Pins per renderer: predicate true shows the reason on hover and focus; controls are predicate false and loading.

Relation: this card follows objectui#11811; claim it after that card lands, so the key and the pattern exist on `main`.
